trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with `healthy: false` and an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the latest deploy and unhealthy, while v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully (`status: rolled_out`).

3. **Opened incident**: Created a **SEV2** incident (INC-0002) for checkout-api describing the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer was paged. (The first attempt timed out, so I verified no incident existed and retried successfully.)

Note: I did not deploy any new version — the rollback used a previously healthy production release, so no change-manager approval was required.
